messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times and I'm totally certain it was the same coin.

output.original_text: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times and I'm totally certain it was the same coin.
output.joy: I swear, that coin must have joyfully made its way back to me at least three times, and I’m positively thrilled it was the same one!
output.sadness: I swear, that coin must have sadly circulated back to me at least three times, and I'm just so disappointed it was the same one.
output.fear: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times, and I can't shake the eerie feeling it was the same coin lurking around.
output.anger: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times, and I'm furious it was the same coin every single time!
output.surprise: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times, and I can't believe it was the exact same coin!
output.disgust: I swear, it must have circulated back to me at least three times, and I'm just grossed out that it was the same coin.
